description: Gray out games with no lines and add real-time updates when games start

userStories.title: Gray out games with no available betting lines
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see games without betting lines displayed as grayed out so I understand why I can't bet on them.
acceptanceCriteria: Games with no markets (empty markets array) appear grayed out in player's game list
Grayed out games show 'No lines available' text or badge
Grayed out games are not tappable / cannot open bet slip
Grayed out games appear at bottom of their section (after bettable games)
Uses Theme.textSecondary or reduced opacity for disabled state
userStories.notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED - hasBettableLines not found in codebase

userStories.title: Add real-time timer to update games list
userStories.description: As a player, I want games to update in real-time as they start so I only see current betting options.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Timer that fires every 30-60 seconds to re-evaluate games list
Games where startTime <= now are filtered out when timer fires
No visual flicker or jarring transitions when games disappear
Timer only runs when player's games view is visible
userStories.notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no Timer found in GamesView

userStories.title: Create helper to check if game has bettable lines
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a clean way to check if a game has valid betting lines.
acceptanceCriteria: Add computed property or helper function: hasBettableLines on Event or as extension
Returns true if event has at least one market with valid odds (non-nil, non-zero)
Used by both graying logic and filtering logic
userStories.notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED - helper does not exist
